deviation_positions.explanation: With legacy eligibility matched to project_target_v1 the frozen policy declares RAMI verbally with no card, which project_target_v1 cannot express; the port shows the lowest eligible off-colour card and derives verbal_required.
With the frozen default banned set {2, J, Q, K} the legacy policy shows a red ten. project_target_v1 restricts show ranks to 3-9, so the port cannot reproduce that card.

equivalence_claim: Agreement is asserted only for the curated positions marked compatible, with the legacy banned-rank set configured to match project_target_v1 show eligibility. Complete behavioural equivalence across the two rule sets is not claimed.
